proof.text: Obtain the descended level objects and their cohomology, the pointwise local Isom stalk sections, and the consecutive normalized arrows from three strictly smaller finite-level obligations; package these fields into the actual-level structure.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AL and 09C6; concrete assembly from the three levelwise obligations

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_levels
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicActualLevelData X d M V T)
